_comment: Drex decision-model wiring for BOTH QwenPaw agents (default + QA). Applied by apply_decision_model_drex.py on the machine; this file is the source of truth for what gets written. No key lives here -- the NACE key is supplied separately (env / QwenPaw encrypted env store) and is never committed.

endpoint.note: QwenPaw's ModelSlotConfig {provider_id, model} has NO endpoint field, so the endpoint does not go in agent.json. It lives in the environment: NACE_BASE_URL (default https://console.nace.ai, read by features/decisions/decide.py) and the key in NACE_API_KEY. A decision model is NOT a chat model: never put this provider/model in active_model or fallback_models -- /v1/chat/completions would 404.

provider_registration_caveat: provider_id 'nace' must resolve in QwenPaw's provider registry for the slot to do anything. The fork (gogibeta/rakazo PR #8, 'Nace Drex as decision provider + decide tool') added Drex as a decision provider in the fork codebase; whether the deployed QwenPaw image carries a 'nace' provider registration is NOT verified. Before flipping approval_level to JEV, the parent must confirm on the machine that the provider resolves (see README.md). If it does not resolve, the slot is inert -- the decide.py client in this directory is the adapter that still needs a registry entry or a security/decision_model.py call path. approval_level is NOT changed by this wiring (another builder owns the SMART approval patch).
